commands.name: Show kubectl version
commands.description: Print the local kubectl client version.

commands.name: List cluster contexts
commands.description: List Kubernetes contexts configured for kubectl.

commands.name: Show current cluster context
commands.description: Print the cluster context kubectl will use.

commands.name: Switch cluster context
commands.description: Select a configured Kubernetes cluster context.

commands.name: List namespaces
commands.description: List namespaces in the current cluster.

commands.name: List pods
commands.description: List pods in the current namespace.

commands.name: Find pods by label
commands.description: List pods matching a label selector.

commands.name: List deployments
commands.description: List deployments in the current namespace.

commands.name: List services
commands.description: List services in the current namespace.

commands.name: List cluster nodes
commands.description: Show cluster nodes and their addresses and status.

commands.name: Describe a pod
commands.description: Show pod details and recent events for troubleshooting.

commands.name: Read pod logs
commands.description: Print logs from a pod's default container.

commands.name: Read previous container logs
commands.description: Read logs from the previous container instance after a restart.

commands.name: Open a shell in a pod
commands.description: Start an interactive shell in a running pod.

commands.name: Apply a Kubernetes manifest
commands.description: Create or update cluster resources declared in a manifest.

commands.name: Preview manifest changes
commands.description: Compare a manifest with the live cluster before applying it.

commands.name: Preview resource deletion
commands.description: Ask the API server to validate a delete without removing resources.

commands.name: Delete a Kubernetes resource
commands.description: Delete resources declared in a manifest from the current cluster.

commands.name: Check deployment rollout
commands.description: Wait for a deployment rollout to complete and report its status.

commands.name: Restart a deployment
commands.description: Trigger a rolling restart of deployment pods.

commands.name: Scale a deployment
commands.description: Set the desired replica count for a deployment.

commands.name: Forward a local port to a pod
commands.description: Forward a local port to a port on a pod for testing.

commands.name: Show recent cluster events
commands.description: List events in time order for cluster troubleshooting.

commands.name: Check pod resource usage
commands.description: Show CPU and memory usage for pods when metrics-server is available.

commands.name: Check Kubernetes permissions
commands.description: Check whether the current identity is authorized to perform an action.
examples: kubectl auth can-i create deployments -n staging
